calls.title: GrowthBook Demo for Journi
calls.summary: The team decided to outsource feature flag and experimentation management to address rising complexity and the need for consistent data across iOS, Android, and web platforms. Current in-house systems cannot scale adequately, leading to a preference for self-hosted or enterprise-grade solutions that ensure trustable data, security, and GDPR compliance. With expected growth in experiment volume, they require a flexible pricing model based on per-experiment fees, which accommodates increased usage. Integration with existing analytics platforms like Amplitude is crucial for tracking metrics, while automated metric monitoring ensures rollout safety. The meeting concluded with plans for further evaluation and in-depth demos focusing on real use cases and seamless integration.
calls.keywords: feature flags, experimentation, rollout safety, multivariate tests, Amplitude integration, GDPR compliance
